workloads.name: calls
workloads.source: func plus(n) { return n + 1 } mut n := 0 while n < 10000 { n = plus(n) } print(n)

workloads.name: captures_generators
workloads.source: func factory(n) { func get() { return n } return get } func* numbers() { yield 1 yield 2 } mut i := 0 mut total := 0 while i < 1000 { let f := factory(i) total += f() let g := numbers() for v in g { total += v } i += 1 } print(total)

workloads.name: tasks
workloads.source: async func work(n) { return n + 1 } mut n := 0 while n < 100 { n = await work(n) } print(n)
